privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.heroDesc: FinCalix collects zero personal data. No backend, no database, no server-side storage. Everything stays on your device.
privacyPolicy.sec1Desc: FinCalix does NOT collect any personal information whatsoever.
privacyPolicy.sec1Li1: No name, email address, phone number, or postal address is collected
privacyPolicy.sec1Li2: No financial data (salary, investments, EMI amounts) is collected
privacyPolicy.sec1Li3: No account creation or login is required to use the app
privacyPolicy.sec1Li4: No user profiles are created or stored
privacyPolicy.sec1End: You can open the app and start calculating instantly — we never ask for any personal details.
privacyPolicy.sec2Desc: FinCalix stores the following data locally on your device only using your browser's LocalStorage:
privacyPolicy.sec2Li1: Calculation inputs — Numbers you enter in calculators
privacyPolicy.sec2Li2: Recently used calculators — For quick access on the home screen
privacyPolicy.sec2Li3: Saved calculations — When you manually save a result
privacyPolicy.sec2BoxTitle: 🔒 This data stays on your device permanently until you:
privacyPolicy.sec2BoxLi1: Clear the app data from your device settings
privacyPolicy.sec2BoxEnd: We have absolutely zero access to this data. It never leaves your device and is never synced to any server.
privacyPolicy.sec3Desc: We use limited analytics (Firebase Analytics) to understand app usage and improve performance. No personal or financial data is ever collected.
privacyPolicy.sec3End: All analytics data is fully anonymous and cannot be linked to any individual.
privacyPolicy.sec4Desc: FinCalix uses the following third-party service for analytics:
privacyPolicy.gaDesc: Anonymous usage statistics only. No personal data is transmitted.
privacyPolicy.vercelDesc: All calculations happen 100% on your device. No API calls. No cloud sync. No data transmission of any kind.
privacyPolicy.sec4End: No advertising networks, tracking pixels, or data-selling services are used.
privacyPolicy.sec5Li1: All numbers you enter (salary, EMI, tax inputs, SIP amounts, etc.) are processed entirely on your device
privacyPolicy.sec5Li2: We never see, store, or transmit your financial figures
privacyPolicy.sec5Li3: All calculations happen in your browser/app — not on any server
privacyPolicy.sec5Li4: There is no backend or API that receives your data
privacyPolicy.sec6P1: FinCalix is designed for users 18 years of age and above. The app contains financial calculators intended for adult use (tax planning, loan EMI, investment returns, etc.).
privacyPolicy.sec6P2: We do not knowingly collect data from anyone under 18 years of age. Since we collect no personal data at all, there is no risk of children's data being stored.
privacyPolicy.sec7Desc: Since FinCalix stores nothing on any server, there is no server-side data breach risk.
privacyPolicy.sec7Li1: Your data security equals your device security
privacyPolicy.sec7Li2: All web traffic uses HTTPS encryption
privacyPolicy.sec7Li3: We recommend using a device lock screen (PIN, fingerprint, face unlock) to protect your locally stored data
privacyPolicy.accessDesc: All your data is visible directly in the app (Saved Calculations, History, Preferences).
privacyPolicy.deleteDesc: Clear app data from your device settings, or simply uninstall the app. All data is removed instantly.
privacyPolicy.portabilityDesc: We cannot delete data on your behalf because we never had it. You have full control.
privacyPolicy.sec9P1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will update the 'Last Updated' date at the top of this page.
privacyPolicy.sec9P2: Continued use of FinCalix after changes to this policy constitutes acceptance of the updated terms. We encourage you to review this page periodically.
privacyPolicy.sec10Desc: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, feel free to reach out:
privacyPolicy.viewDataSafety: View Data & Privacy (Play Store Data Safety)
privacyPolicy.sec11Desc: We use analytics tools to understand app usage and improve performance. These tools may change over time, but we ensure no personal or financial data is collected.
privacyPolicy.sec11BoxLi1: All calculations are performed locally on your device.
privacyPolicy.sec11BoxLi2: No financial data is stored on our servers.

term.title: Pure Term Insurance
term.what: Pays the death benefit only. Zero maturity payout.
term.note: For every 1Cr of protection, pure term costs 6,000-18,000/year. This is the most cost-efficient life cover available. Invest the premium savings in mutual funds via SIP.

trop.title: Term + Return of Premium (TROP)
trop.what: Pays all premiums back if you survive the full policy term.
trop.note: You get your premiums back, but the effective return is only 2.5-4% XIRR — below inflation and below FD rates. Better than Endowment. Choose only if you cannot tolerate paying for pure term.

endowment.title: Endowment / Money Back Plan
endowment.what: A mix of life insurance + guaranteed savings.
endowment.maturity: Lower than premiums paid in real terms
endowment.note: You pay 6-8x more premium than term for the same cover. Returns are below Fixed Deposit rates. Classic trap: mixing insurance with investment destroys both. Use term + SIP instead.

ulip.title: ULIP (Market-Linked Plan)
ulip.what: Life insurance combined with a market-linked investment fund.
ulip.xirr: 7%-11% if equity performs; high charges in years 1-5
ulip.note: ULIPs can generate decent returns over 15+ years if equity performs. But high charges in years 1-5 significantly reduce real XIRR. Better alternative for most: pure term + separate ELSS SIP.

checklist.roomRentBody: Ensure the plan has NO sub-limit on room rent. A plan capping room rent at 5,000/day in a metro hospital means ALL linked charges (doctor fees, nursing, procedures) are also proportionally reduced. Avoid any plan with room rent sub-limits.
checklist.restorationBody: After one member uses up the sum insured, it should automatically restore — either once per year or unlimited. This is critical for families where multiple members may need hospitalisation. Ask: Does restoration apply to the same illness or a different illness? Unlimited is better.
checklist.ncbBody: Every claim-free year should increase your sum insured by 10-50% at no extra cost. Check: 1) What % NCB per year? 2) Is NCB protected after a small claim? 3) What is the maximum NCB cap? (50% is good, 100% is excellent)
checklist.pedBody: IRDAI 2025 rules: maximum PED waiting period is now 36 months (3 years) for new policies. Shorter is better. Look for plans with 36-month or less PED waiting. After the waiting period, your pre-existing conditions must be covered. Never hide a pre-existing condition — it is the #1 cause of claim rejection.
checklist.renewBody: Under IRDAI HIR 2016 Regulation 12, any policy renewed without a break cannot be denied renewal due to age. Ensure the policy explicitly states Lifelong Renewable. Never let your health policy lapse — you lose accumulated waiting period credits.
checklist.csrBody: CSR = claims settled / claims received x 100. Look for CSR above 95%. Verify from IRDAI's official annual report at irdai.gov.in — not from broker or comparison websites. Also check the Complaint Volume per 10,000 claims — lower complaints = smoother process.
checklist.tpaBody: Insurers that process claims in-house (no Third Party Administrator) typically settle faster and with fewer disputes. When buying, ask the insurer: Who processes my cashless claims at the hospital? In-house = better.
checklist.seniorBody: Adding parents 60+ to a family floater increases premium for the entire family. Consider a dedicated senior citizen plan. Compare: family floater vs separate senior plan pricing.
checklist.infantBody: Verify the insurer's newborn clause: Is the baby auto-covered from birth? Do you need to inform within 90 days? Is there an extra premium for adding the child?
checklist.floaterBody: Family floaters assume not all members claim in the same year. With 5+ members, the probability of multiple claims increases. Consider buying individual covers for high-risk members (seniors, those with pre-existing conditions) and keeping the floater only for younger, healthy members. Get quotes for both structures.
checklist.newbornCoverBody: Newborns should be covered from Day 1 or within 90 days without a fresh waiting period. Check the exact newborn clause in the policy wording document — not the brochure.
checklist.vaccineBody: Some plans cover routine vaccinations under OPD benefit. Check if this is included or available as an add-on. Useful for families with young children.
checklist.seniorCopayBody: Many plans add a co-payment clause for members above 60 — meaning you pay 10-20% of every claim. This defeats the purpose of insurance for seniors. Look specifically for plans with ZERO co-payment regardless of age.
checklist.seniorSeparateBody: Including parents above 60 in a family floater raises the entire family's premium significantly. Often it is cheaper to buy a dedicated senior citizen plan for parents and keep the main family floater for younger members. Get quotes both ways from IRDAI-registered insurers before deciding.
checklist.elderlyBody: Above age 70, very few insurers accept new proposals. If a parent has an existing policy, NEVER let it lapse — renewal cannot be denied under IRDAI rules. If no existing policy, check IRDAI's list of senior-friendly products at irdai.gov.in.
checklist.pedDeclareBody: Disclose ALL pre-existing conditions accurately in your proposal form. Under IRDAI's moratorium period rules (5 years as of 2024), after 5 years of continuous coverage, your insurer CANNOT reject claims citing non-disclosure (except proven fraud). Never hide conditions — claims get rejected at the worst time.
checklist.siWarnBody: In metro cities, a single surgery with ICU stay costs 3-8 lakhs on average. A cardiac bypass or cancer treatment can cost 8-20 lakhs. 5L cover is inadequate for metro hospitals. Consider 15-25L minimum for families in Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad.

irdaiRights.noAgeTitle: No Age Limit for New Policies
irdaiRights.noAgeBody: Insurers cannot deny new health insurance based on age. (IRDAI 2025 guideline)
irdaiRights.pedWaitBody: Waiting period for pre-existing diseases capped at 36 months for new policies. (IRDAI 2025)
irdaiRights.lifetimeBody: No policy can be denied renewal due to age if renewed without break. (IRDAI HIR 2016 Reg 12)
irdaiRights.moratoriumBody: After 5 years continuous coverage, insurer cannot reject claims citing non-disclosure (except fraud). (IRDAI Master Circular 2024)
irdaiRights.renewCapBody: Insurers cannot increase renewal premium for policyholders above 65 by more than 10% per year. (IRDAI Circular January 2025)
irdaiRights.freeLookBody: You can return the policy within 30 days for a full refund if unsatisfied. (IRDAI free-look rule)
irdaiRights.cashlessBody: Emergency cashless treatment allowed even at non-network hospitals. (IRDAI initiative 2024)
irdaiRights.gstBody: Individual health insurance premiums are GST exempt from September 22, 2025. (56th GST Council)
irdaiRights.portabilityBody: Switch insurer without losing accrued waiting period benefits. Apply 45 days before renewal.
irdaiRights.ombudsmanBody: Free dispute resolution if claim is rejected. File at irdai.gov.in — no lawyer needed.

howToBuy.step1Body: Before comparing premiums, decide your sum insured. Rule of thumb: 1 year of gross income OR minimum 10L for Tier 2/3, 15-25L for metro. Medical inflation is 14%/year in India — choose a sum insured that will still be adequate in 10 years.
howToBuy.step2Body: Go to irdai.gov.in → Statistics → Annual Report. Check Claim Settlement Ratio and Complaint Volume per 10,000 claims. Focus on insurers with CSR above 95% AND complaint ratio below 20.
howToBuy.step3Title: Read the Policy Wording — not the brochure
howToBuy.step3Body: The brochure shows benefits. The Policy Wording Document shows exclusions, sub-limits, and conditions. Search for: room rent, co-pay, sub-limit, waiting period, restoration. These are your risk areas.
howToBuy.step4Title: Get quotes for the same sum insured from 3 insurers
howToBuy.step4Body: Visit 3 insurer websites directly and get quotes for identical sum insured and members. Do not compare a 10L plan from one insurer with a 5L plan from another.
howToBuy.step5Title: Check network hospitals in your city
howToBuy.step5Body: Visit the insurer's website directly and search your preferred hospital name in their network. Do not rely on broker sites for this check — hospital lists change frequently.
howToBuy.step6Title: Buy directly from the insurer website
howToBuy.step6Body: Buying directly (insurer website or app) is cheaper than through a broker — no commission loading. You can still use a broker for advice, but buy direct to avoid markup.
howToBuy.step7Body: Fill the proposal form yourself. Disclose all pre-existing conditions, past surgeries, family medical history. Non-disclosure = claim rejection at the worst possible time.

fd.text: Maturity amounts are estimated based on the rates entered. Current interest rates vary by bank, tenure, and deposit amount. Check your bank's website for today's exact rates.

rd.title: RD Maturity
rd.text: Maturity amounts are estimated based on entered rates and compounding frequency. Actual returns may differ slightly based on your bank's specific compounding rules.

ppf.title: PPF Rules
ppf.text: PPF has a mandatory 15-year lock-in with specific conditions for partial withdrawals. The interest rate is reviewed and set quarterly by the government.

hra.title: HRA Exemption
hra.text: HRA exemption is calculated based on Sec 10(13A) of the Income Tax Act. It requires valid rent receipts and PAN details of the landlord for higher amounts.

gratuity.title: Gratuity Act
gratuity.text: Gratuity estimates are based on the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972. Eligibility requires continuous service of five years with the same employer.

gst.title: GST Rates
gst.text: GST calculations are based on standard slab rates for general goods and services. Rates for specific items can vary based on their HSN/SAC codes. Confirm the exact rate on gst.gov.in.

advisor.title: Financial Advice
advisor.text: Recommendations are algorithmically generated based on your inputs. Use this as a starting point for your financial roadmap. For crucial decisions, please consult a certified financial planner.

goal.title: Goal Projections
goal.text: Projections illustrate the monthly savings required to hit your target amounts. They do not account for inflation or changing tax rates. Revisit your goals periodically.

expense.title: Data Privacy
expense.text: All expense data is stored completely locally on your device. We do not transmit, collect, or store your financial habits. You can clear your data anytime from Settings.

compare.title: Comparison Metrics
compare.text: Comparisons are strictly mathematical based on the provided assumptions. Real-world scenarios involve inflation, tax implications, and changing interest rates. Use these as a directional guide only.

schemes.title: Government Schemes
schemes.text: Scheme details are provided for general educational purposes. Eligibility criteria and benefits are subject to change by ministries. Always verify details on the official portals before applying.

general.title: Disclaimer
general.text: The calculations provided are estimates for informational and planning purposes only. They should not be considered formal financial advice. Please verify specific figures with your financial institution.

time.title: Time & Utility Data
time.text: Data is provided for general informational purposes only. Time zones, daylight saving changes, and calculations may vary slightly depending on system data.

scientific.title: Scientific Calculator
scientific.text: Results are approximate and intended for informational use only. Floating-point precision limitations may cause minor rounding differences.

swp.title: SWP Projections
swp.text: Systematic Withdrawal Plan projections assume a constant rate of return. Actual mutual fund returns fluctuate with market conditions. Your corpus may deplete faster or slower than projected.

cagr.title: CAGR Note
cagr.text: CAGR represents a smoothed annual growth rate and does not reflect actual year-to-year volatility. Past performance is not indicative of future results.

lumpsum.title: Lumpsum Investment
lumpsum.text: Lumpsum projections are based on assumed constant returns. Actual market returns vary significantly. Mutual fund investments are subject to market risks.

epf.title: EPF Rates
epf.text: EPF interest rates are set annually by the EPFO and Government of India. The rate used here is based on the latest declared rate. Actual credited interest may differ.

nps.title: NPS Returns
nps.text: NPS returns are market-linked and vary by fund manager and asset class. The projections shown are indicative only. Verify your actual returns on the NPS portal.

ssy.title: SSY Interest
ssy.text: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana interest rates are reviewed and set quarterly by the Government of India. Current rates may differ from those used in this calculation.

nsc.title: NSC Rates
nsc.text: National Savings Certificate rates are set by the Ministry of Finance and reviewed quarterly. Confirm rates at your nearest Post Office.

kvp.title: KVP Doubling
kvp.text: Kisan Vikas Patra doubling time is based on the current government-declared rate. Rates are reviewed quarterly. Confirm the exact maturity period before investing.

pomis.title: POMIS Monthly Income
pomis.text: Post Office Monthly Income Scheme interest rates are reviewed quarterly by the Government. Monthly payout amounts shown are based on the current rate.

potd.title: Post Office TD
potd.text: Post Office Time Deposit rates are set quarterly by the Government. Maturity amounts are estimated based on the latest declared rates.

scss.title: SCSS Eligibility
scss.text: Senior Citizens Savings Scheme interest rates are reviewed quarterly. Eligibility is restricted to individuals aged 60 and above (55 for retired defence personnel).

budget.title: Budget Data
budget.text: All budget and expense data is stored locally on your device. Insights and recommendations are generated algorithmically and should not be considered professional financial advice.

insurance.title: Insurance Estimates
insurance.text: Premium estimates are indicative and based on general actuarial factors. Actual premiums vary by insurer, underwriting criteria, medical history, and policy terms. This tool is for comparison purposes only.

mortgage.title: Mortgage Calculator
mortgage.text: Home loan EMI, prepayment, and foreclosure calculations are based on standard reducing balance method. Actual EMI, charges, and tax benefits may vary by lender and RBI guidelines. Consult your bank for exact figures.

property.title: Property Valuation
property.text: Property cost estimates including registration, stamp duty, and GST are approximate and based on general rates. Actual charges vary by state, local body, and property type. Verify with your local sub-registrar office.

od.title: Overdraft Calculator
od.subtitle: Optimize your working capital & limit utilization
od.exceedsWarning: Warning: Penalty applies on excess utilization.
od.excessPenaltyHint: Added on top of base rate when utilized > sanctioned limit. Typically 2%.
od.odPreclosureDesc: Usually Nil or very low. Flexibility to repay anytime.
od.plPreclosureDesc: High penalty, typically up to 4-5% of balance.
od.odBestForDesc: Short-term cash flow needs, working capital.
od.smartVerdictDesc: Based on your {{days}} days usage, OD is significantly cheaper than a typical personal loan because you only pay for the exact days you borrow.
od.tipDailyDesc: Deposit cash back to OD account as soon as possible, even for weekends, to save on daily accrued interest.
od.tipDepositDesc: Route all your incoming payments into the OD account to keep the utilized balance as low as possible.
od.tipBreachDesc: Exceeding the sanctioned limit triggers heavy penal interest (usually +2% to +4%). Keep a buffer for safety.
od.tipRenegotiateDesc: If your limit utilization is consistently high and credit score is good, request your bank for a lower interest rate.

cagr.title: CAGR Calculator
cagr.subtitle: Compound Annual Growth Rate
cagr.totalGrowthOverPeriod: Total growth over the entire period
cagr.whyCAGRDescription: CAGR removes volatility and shows a single, consistent growth rate equivalent, making it ideal for comparing investments.
cagr.finalValueExceedsTarget: Your final value of {{value}} exceeds your target!

ci.title: Compound Interest
ci.subtitle: Advanced CI Calculator
ci.insightInflationWarn: Your rate ({{rate}}%) is at or below inflation ({{inflation}}%). Your real returns may be zero or negative.
ci.insightLongTerm: Long-term compounding is powerful! Your money grew {{multiplier}}x over this period.
ci.insightHighRate: High return rates (>15%) are typically volatile. Consider diversifying your portfolio.
ci.insightDefault: Compound interest rewards patience. The longer you stay invested, the more your money grows.
ci.inflationDescription: Purchasing power erodes over time. This shows the real value of your maturity amount after adjusting for inflation.

si.title: Interest Calculator
si.subtitle: Flat, Simple & Compound
si.avgPaymentNote: Note: In CI, actual monthly obligations differ. This is the total ÷ tenure average.

gst.title: GST Calculator
gst.subtitle: Goods & Services Tax
gst.totalGSTPaidHelper: Total GST paid on all purchases

hra.title: HRA Calculator
hra.subtitle: House Rent Allowance
hra.newRegimeWarning: Under the New Tax Regime, HRA exemption is not available. All HRA received is fully taxable.
hra.daNote: DA (Dearness Allowance) is added to Basic for HRA calculation. Leave 0 if not applicable.
hra.insightNewRegime: Under the new tax regime, HRA exemption is not available. Consider switching to the old regime if your HRA exemption is significant.
hra.insightZeroExemption: Your HRA exemption is zero. Check if your rent exceeds 10% of your Basic+DA.
hra.insightHraLimiting: Your actual HRA received is the limiting factor. Negotiating a higher HRA component could increase your exemption.
hra.insightSalaryLimiting: The {{pct}} of Basic+DA rule is limiting your exemption. A higher basic salary would help.
hra.insightRentLimiting: Rent minus 10% of salary is the limiting factor. Consider increasing documented rent to maximize exemption.
hra.insightDefault: Your HRA exemption is optimally calculated based on the minimum of three conditions.
hra.whatIfDescription: Adjust the sliders to see how changes in rent or salary affect your HRA exemption and tax savings.
hra.documentsIntro: To claim HRA exemption of {{amount}}, keep these documents ready:
hra.doc1: Rent receipts (signed by landlord) for the financial year
hra.doc4: Bank statement showing rent payments (if paid via transfer)

kvp.title: KVP Calculator
kvp.subtitle: Kisan Vikas Patra
kvp.no80CDeductionNote: KVP does not qualify for Section 80C deduction. Interest is taxable under Income from Other Sources (IFOS).
kvp.realReturnBeatsInflation: Post-tax real return beats inflation by {{percent}}% — your purchasing power grows.
kvp.inflationOutpacesReturn: Inflation ({{inflation}}%) outpaces post-tax return ({{postTaxCAGR}}%). Consider higher-yield alternatives.

pomis.title: Post Office MIS
pomis.subtitle: Monthly Income Scheme
pomis.amountExceedsLimit: Amount exceeds the {{limit}}L limit. Investment will be capped.
pomis.postTaxBelowInflation: Post-tax yield ({{yield}}%) is below inflation ({{inflation}}%). Real purchasing power may erode.
pomis.cashflowBeatsInflation: Cashflow yield beats inflation — your monthly income retains purchasing power.

potd.title: Post Office TD
potd.subtitle: Time Deposit Calculator
potd.sec80CEligible: 5-Year TD is eligible for Sec 80C / 123 deduction
potd.fiveYearTenureBenefit: 5-Year TD qualifies for Sec 80C / 123 tax deduction (up to ₹1.5L) — giving you an upfront tax benefit.
potd.noTaxBenefitTenure: {{years}}-Year tenure does not qualify for Sec 80C. Consider 5-Year TD for tax benefits.

scss.title: SCSS Calculator
scss.subtitle: Senior Citizen Savings Scheme
scss.extensionNote: 3-year extension available at the prevailing rate at the time of maturity
scss.tdsApplicableDesc: Annual interest ({{annualInterest}}) exceeds ₹50,000. TDS of {{annualTDS}} (10%) will be deducted.
scss.interestTaxabilityDesc: SCSS interest is fully taxable under 'Income from Other Sources' at your slab rate.
scss.tdsThresholdDesc: TDS @10% is deducted if annual interest exceeds ₹50,000.
scss.form15HDesc: Submit Form 15H to the post office to avoid TDS if your total income is below the taxable limit.
scss.sec80CBenefitDesc: SCSS investment qualifies for deduction under Section 80C (up to ₹1.5 lakh).
scss.jointAccountDesc: Allowed with spouse. First depositor is the primary investor for 80C purposes.
scss.penaltyNote: Interest earned up to the premature withdrawal date will be paid out. Penalty is on the principal only.

salary.title: Salary Hike Calculator
salary.subtitle: Increment & CTC Planner
salary.hikeBeatsInflation: Your hike beats inflation by {{diff}}% — real purchasing power increases.
salary.hikeBelowInflation: Your hike is below India's inflation rate ({{inflation}}%). Real purchasing power may decline.
salary.benchExcellent: Excellent! Your hike is near top-performer levels.
salary.benchAboveAvg: Good. Your hike is above the industry average.
salary.benchBelowAvg: Below average for your industry. Consider negotiating.
salary.benchSignificantlyBelow: Significantly below industry average. Time to reassess.
salary.benchmarkSource: Source: Aon Salary Survey 2026, EY Future of Pay
salary.taxDisclaimer: Approximate tax based on New Regime FY 2026-27. Actual tax may vary.
salary.customVariableHikeLabel: Use a different hike % for variable pay
salary.takeHomeDisclaimer: Approximate. Excludes HRA, LTA, meal coupons, and other deductions.
salary.compareDisclaimer: Comparison is indicative. Consider role scope, growth, benefits, and work-life balance beyond numbers.
salary.projectionDisclaimer: Projections assume a constant hike rate. Actual salary changes depend on performance, market conditions, and company policies.

property.title: Property Calculator
property.subtitle: Land, Flat, Villa & More
property.premiumTip: Corner/road facing plots typically command a 3-10% premium
property.stampDutyDisclaimer: Rates are indicative. Actual stamp duty varies by state, property type, and buyer category.
